scenicChapters.title: Le Grand Lac de Clairvaux → From the Great Saltworks of Salins-les-Bai
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 57 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-le-grand-lac-de-clairvaux-le-locl.story: A 365 km round trip from Clairvaux-les-Lacs - roughly 6 h 18 in the saddle. It goes by way of From the Great Saltworks of Salins-les-Bai, Fortifications of Vauban, Le Locle and back through Fortifications of Vauban. The highest point is about 900 m. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
